mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.25%, it signals a tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.25%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both PAYEMS and UNRATE move in the expected direction, or the interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05) in a regression.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, rising housing starts (HOUST) and strong GDP growth (GDPC1) signal robust economic activity that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansions with rising HOUST and GDPC1, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates economic weakness that depresses corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment exceeds 7.0%, it signals a severe labor market downturn that triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL) and declining industrial production (INDPRO) indicate stagflationary pressures that reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises and INDPRO falls, or the interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05) in a regression.

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recovery regimes, rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals improving supply chain conditions that boost corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during post-shock recovery with rising INDPRO, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.
